title: Every merge to main produces an uploaded version at a stable preview alias URL
iWant: a stable preview URL that always resolves to the newest-of-main uploaded version
soThat: I can look at the change on a live surface without waiting for a production promote

acceptanceCriteria.description: A successful `build-and-upload` CI run on a merge to main leaves the preview alias URL resolving to the version id the run just uploaded, and the version-id URL resolving to the same version permanently.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a merge to main triggers `build-and-upload` and it exits zero with recorded `versionId` V and `previewAliasUrl` A and `versionIdUrl` U
acceptanceCriteria.when: an HTTP request hits A and then a second HTTP request hits U within five minutes of the run completing
acceptanceCriteria.then: both responses carry the `versionSha` field of V's build provenance in the health-probe body, and the two responses agree on that field

acceptanceCriteria.description: A subsequent merge that produces a new upload W leaves the preview alias URL resolving to W while the version-id URL for the previous version V still resolves to V.
acceptanceCriteria.given: an upload V behind preview alias A followed by a fresh merge that produces upload W
acceptanceCriteria.when: requests hit A and the version-id URLs for V and W after W's run completes
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response at A carries W's `versionSha`; the response at V's version-id URL still carries V's `versionSha`; the two are distinct

acceptanceCriteria.description: The uploaded version does not serve production traffic; the production URL continues to serve the version that was serving before the upload.
acceptanceCriteria.given: production is serving version P and a merge lands producing upload W
acceptanceCriteria.when: the `build-and-upload` run completes and no promote has run
acceptanceCriteria.then: the production URL's health probe carries P's `versionSha`, not W's
